question: A project manager started with 231 tasks. She subtracted 13 tasks completed. She added 7 tasks from scope creep. She subtracted 31 tasks from delegation. She multiplied by 5 for team scaling (measured in team-scaled tasks). Michael and Sarah compared their task loads. His workload was 19 tasks (separate). What was the team-scaled task count?

A model shop received 158 kits and sent 20 of them back because parts were missing. Every kit that stayed contains 4 sprues. Each sprue holds 8 small plastic pieces. A supplier sent 33 loose pieces to replace breakages. Each piece needs 3 drops of glue to fix it in place. The shop has been open for a dozen years. How many drops of glue would the whole stock need?
Amy worked 126 minutes on a project. She doubled her work time, added 41 minutes for review, removed 244 minutes as overestimate, and added 31 final minutes. How many hours did she spend total?

Two friends compared their trading card totals. Farah had 34 cards, even though the shop carries 60 different sets, tracked over 60 minutes, or 1 hour, of trading. She lost 15 cards in a bad trade. A matching donation from a friend doubled her total. She then won 42 more cards in a tournament. A second tournament added 38 more. Finally, a grand prize added 76 more cards, leaving her with more cards than her friend Tomas, who had only 150. How many cards did Farah end up with?

In the morning 4 lorries pulled into the grain yard, and each lorry carried 234 sacks. Half of the lorries in the fleet are less than a year old. Before noon 894 sacks were delivered on to the mill down the road. During the afternoon every sack still in the yard was split into 8 smaller bags for the retail trade. In the evening the storeman brought out 45 more bags that had been made up the previous week. How many bags were in the yard?

In the morning, a food bank has 175 cans of soup stacked in its pantry. By midday, a massive donation drive brings the total to 2 times what it was. In the afternoon, a distribution event to local families uses up 248 cans from the shelves. A radio announcement that same afternoon mentioned 60 volunteers helping citywide, though that number has no effect on the can count. By evening, another wave of donations brings the pantry to 9 times the cans it had left. Late that evening, a final distribution to a shelter takes away 403 cans. How many cans of soup remain in the pantry?
A builder had 176 bricks. He multiplied by 8. He multiplied by 9. He removed 8836. He added 24 more. About 50 bricks were defective, which is unrelated. How many bricks?

A manufacturer scaled production. Starting run: 224 items. He multiplied by 2 for double shift. He multiplied by 7 for weekly demand. He multiplied by 6 for monthly supply. He added 56 bonus items. He worked morning through evening. How many items monthly?

A student began with 125 problems. She subtracted 118 problems already mastered. She added 79 problems from a new chapter. She added 62 problems from additional practice. She multiplied by 9 for expected study time per problem. She added 18 hours for review sessions. She added 42 hours for final preparation (measured in total study hours). Throughout the term, she studied in the morning before school, afternoons in the library, and evenings at home, with study hours increasing as the exam approached. Her friend had 8 hours allocated (separate count). What was her total study hour allocation?

A student's homework started at 205 points. In the morning, she subtracted 39 points from errors. By afternoon, she added 72 points from corrections. By evening, she subtracted 28 points. The next day, she subtracted 85 points. She then subtracted 84 more points. Her classmate earned 16 extra credit points (separate calculation). Converting to total points, what was her final homework score?

Dee's doctor told her to drink 9 glasses of water a day, and each of her glasses holds 240 millilitres. She also drinks 36 millilitres of water with her morning vitamins and 26 millilitres when she takes her evening tablet. That daily total is more than her flatmate Eli drinks in a day, and Eli owns a dozen water bottles. Dee kept exactly to this routine for all 7 days of last week. How many millilitres of water did Dee drink last week?

Two stamp collectors, Leo and Priti, compared their collections at a convention, and Leo's was noticeably smaller than hers. Priti's album held 160 stamps at the start of the convention, and a trade with another collector added 52 more stamps. A rare-set bonus then made her collection grow to 9 times its size. A special exhibit prize made it grow to 9 times its size once again, while the organizer's 3000 extra entry passes sat unused in a box. Afterward, 14004 stamps had to be returned to their rightful owners after an authentication review found they didn't belong to her. How many stamps remained in Priti's album?

On Monday morning the hardware store had 189 boxes of screws in the stockroom. Before lunch 121 of the boxes were sold to a builder. Each box that remained holds 6 packets of screws. In the afternoon the manager Grace removed 22 damaged packets, and in the evening her colleague Ben returned 22 packets he had borrowed, leaving Ben with fewer packets than Grace had on the shelf. A dozen of the packets are labelled for brass screws. Overnight the warehouse replaced every packet in the stockroom with 9 smaller sachets. How many sachets were in the stockroom on Tuesday?

A single food pantry started the month with 196 pounds of rice. A large distribution used 158 pounds for local families, and a grocery donation then added 66 more pounds. A school food drive used 73 more pounds, and a shelter delivery used 25 more, during a week volunteers logged about 120 minutes of sorting, right around 2 hours. A community garden then donated 73 more pounds, but 19 more pounds were sent to a neighboring pantry. A separate donation bin nearby collected about a dozen cans of soup, unrelated to the rice count. How many pounds of rice remained in the pantry?

Two rival bakeries compared their cupcake orders. Sweet Treats had 187 cupcakes ordered, priced at 18,700 cents in total, even though the shop offers 20 flavors. A wedding order added 37 more cupcakes. A birthday order added 47 more. A cancellation then removed 172 cupcakes from the total. Finally, a catering contract made the remaining order seven times as large, well ahead of the rival bakery's order of 400 cupcakes. How many cupcakes did Sweet Treats end up with in their order?
A factory started with 140 units. They multiplied by 9, then by 4, added 12, lost 4051 to failure, and multiplied by 8 for recovery projection. How many units in the recovery projection?

A business had 191 units starting. They added 48 more through production. They removed 89 for customer orders. They removed 149 for returns. They multiplied by 4 for repackaging. They added 66 from a supplier shipment. Sarah had worked there 3 years. How many units were in inventory?

Nadia has 86 sheets of stickers, while her brother Omar has 60 sheets, so she has more than him. Nadia has been collecting stickers for half a year. She buys 16 more sheets at the shop, and every sheet holds 4 stickers. Omar gives her 6 loose stickers as well. She gives away 187 stickers to her classmates, and later finds 13 stickers in her desk drawer. How many stickers does Nadia have now?

Lin's delivery van covers 187 kilometres on its regular weekly route, plus 18 kilometres to the depot and 62 kilometres to the coast each week. She drove that same weekly distance for 8 weeks, which is more than Mia's van covered in the same time. In the last week she also drove 41 kilometres to a special delivery. How many kilometres did Lin's van cover over those 8 weeks?

A smallholder kept 47 hens and bought 27 more at the spring auction. She sold 65 hens to a neighbouring farm, and a fox took 3 more. Each hen she has left lays 4 eggs a week. She also buys 32 eggs a week from a friend to make up her order. Every egg is sold for 6 pence, because her stall lists prices in pence rather than in pounds. How many pence does she take each week?

Lily had 47 seashells in her bucket after a morning at the beach, while her brother Sam had found only 19 seashells in his own bucket. Lily gave 12 seashells to a tide-pool tour guide as a thank-you. She then dropped 3 shells while climbing over some rocks. A sudden wave swept away 27 more shells before she could grab them. She accidentally left 2 shells behind on a picnic table that also held a stack of 15 napkins nobody touched. That evening, a shell-crafting kit turned every shell she still had into 9 polished shells. How many polished shells did Lily end up with?

A warehouse started with 99 boxes. They increased 9 times. They removed 283 boxes. They increased 6 times. Finally, they added 37 boxes. A competitor had 300 boxes. Converting to tens, how many boxes are there?
A collector had 74 pieces. He removed 10. He added 19 more. He removed 74 additional pieces. He removed 8. He added 64 more. During an appraisal, 30 pieces were insured separately. How many pieces?

In the morning a corner shop had 44 six-packs of lemonade on the shelf. The shop is open 10 hours a day. In the afternoon a delivery brought 22 more six-packs and a second van brought 11. Since a six-pack holds 6 cans, the owner counted the stock in cans. In the evening a party group bought 272 cans. How many cans of lemonade were left?

In the morning, a business had 86 items. By midday, 39 items were removed. By afternoon, they increased 5 times. By evening, 15 items were added. Finally, they tripled. A neighboring business had 200 items. How many items do they have?
